name: Obsidian
subtitle: Sony Bravia OLED remote over Wi-Fi, IR and ADB
description: Controls a Sony Bravia straight over Wi-Fi (Sony IP control and IRCC) with the Tuya IR blaster as fallback: power, volume, inputs, apps, every remote button, typing, picture and sound settings, screen off, presets, Cast now playing, widgets including a one-button widget, Control Center and Siri.
